prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Pet Care Commitment", "Promise to give your new companion a cozy spot on your desktop.", "I will keep my pet active on my screen"]
1: ["Review & Seal Your Adoption Certificate", "Your pet is officially ready to join your desktop environment."]
2: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Click to play, right-click to open options, or drag to reposition anywhere on your monitor.", "Right-click pet icon in system tray to quickly hide or exit."]
3: ["We will pop up a notification as soon as your pet is ready on your screen."]
4: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Choose between instant adoption or creating a custom pet from your photos."]
5: ["Configure Desktop Launch Preferences", "Ensure your pet spawns automatically when your computer turns on.", "Enable Auto-Launch at Startup"]
6: ["For best custom rendering, upload bright, front-facing pet photos.", "Bright lighting and clear face shots create the best custom pet details."]
7: ["Secure Your Pet Data", "Sign in now so your custom pet configuration and progress are linked permanently to your account.", "Signing in ensures your pet stays saved even if you reinstall."]
8: ["Building Your Desktop Companion Assets"]
9: ["Select Your Adoption Experience", "Pick a ready-made companion to play immediately, or upload photos to create a custom companion.", "Continue to Adoption"]
